verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware FIDO2/WebAuthn security key (with OATH, PIV and OpenPGP). It has no service or API of its own, so issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials to an agent does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it shipping such a capability: the OpenAPI probe found no API surface, and its authentication roles do not amount to scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
